item.title: GOP backlash cancels Missouri chief justice's annual address
item.description: Missouri Chief Justice W. Brent Powell did not deliver the yearly State of the Judiciary Address Wednesday after the Senate and House failed to meet in a joint session, a move that comes as Republican lawmakers are protesting a recent Missouri Supreme Court ruling.

item.title: Eric Schmitt defends ICE operations, backs challenge to birthright citizenship
item.description: Missouri U.S. Sen. Eric Schmitt has moved this week to publicly defend federal immigration enforcement operations and support a legal challenge aimed at limiting birthright citizenship.

item.title: Don Lemon after release: 'I will not stop now, I will not stop ever'
item.description: Lemon said federal officers arrested him "for something I've been doing for the last 30 years, and that is covering the news."

item.title: Tornado victims seek shelter in vacant sites amid freezing temps
item.description: Survivors of a deadly tornado that hit north St. Louis eight months ago are seeking shelter in vacant buildings as brutal winter weather moves into the region.

item.title: SLMPD officers earn 7% salary increase
item.description: Officers working with the St. Louis Metropolitan Police Department (SLMPD) can now expect a salary increase.

item.title: REVISIT: St. Louis' 'blizzard' of 1982
item.description: As St. Louis is dealing with the remnants of the most recent snow storm, Friday marks the anniversary of one of the highest-ranking snowfalls the city has ever seen.

item.title: Woman fatally shot in Ferguson: Officials
item.description: Homicide detectives from the St. Louis County Police Department (SLCPD) are investigating a shooting that left one person dead Friday afternoon in Ferguson.

item.title: St. Louis-area mail carrier sentenced for stealing checks, selling mail key
item.description: A former St. Louis-area mail carrier who stole mail and aided in a massive check-stealing scheme has been sentenced to prison.

item.title: Manhunt ends after wrong-way crash on I-70 in St. Peters
item.description: Drivers may experience significant traffic backups Friday morning on Interstate 70 in St. Peters following a crash and a possible police chase.

item.title: Jury recommends Kenneth Lee Simpson be sentenced to death in officer's murder
item.description: Following the end of closing arguments in the case of Kenneth Lee Simpson vs. the State of Missouri, jurors have now returned their verdict Friday evening, which has sealed the 38-year-old's fate.
